findings.controls: PASS JSON and PASS Markdown accepted; simple FAIL JSON and ordinary gate-schema record rejected. All input hashes rebound from bytes, so this is not a stale pin test.
findings.fix: Catch DuplicateKey before generic ValueError, refuse it with both JSON positions, and never downgrade a structured duplicate to the unstructured text fallback.
findings.limits: API-level build admission TESTED, not sealed CLI adoption or a scientific launch. Root pinning still constrains which record may be selected; the universal JSON refusal nevertheless fails on selected bytes.
findings.mechanism: check_record_codes lines 869-872 catches DuplicateKey as ValueError, sets obj=None, and proceeds to driver and PASS-token checks. Duplicate schema also bypasses the gate-record disallowance. driver_build_codes 928-929 trusts this result; activate_driver_build accepts the build.
rules: A86.5 NEW adoption may not ease a reading
findings.tested: Five independent duplicate patterns (FAIL then PASS; reverse; equal PASS; nested duplicate; duplicate schema hiding GATE_SCHEMA) are accepted at three original-function boundaries: check_record_codes, driver_build_codes and activate_driver_build. 15 false acceptances. Exact byte-pinned inert r5 files and check records; driver never executed.
findings.title: Duplicate JSON in BUILD check_record falls back to token-scanned text and is admitted

findings.fix: Add the first/repeated header key indices (or their JSON-like paths) alongside the archive member index.

findings.title: Duplicate NPY header-key refusal identifies only the archive member

findings.limits: Seven observations, not additional counted blockers. NEW-73 explicitly adopts a lexical minimum and leaves format to root; fixing the duplicate fallback is required independently. A typed format/authoritative verdict would remove this ambiguity.
findings.tested: Actual check_record_codes and driver_build_codes accept malformed JSON with PASS, quoted PASS-only text, explicit Verdict: FAIL plus unrelated historical PASS, and JSON verdict FAIL with note PASS. PASS_WITH_FINDINGS accepts; no-PASS and wrong-driver controls reject.
